name: prompt-deck
title: PromptDeck
description: Create reusable AI prompts that run on your selected or copied text. Prompts, selected text, and clipboard text are sent to the LLM provider you configure (OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google, including OpenAI-compatible endpoints).
author: tadassuksteris

commands.name: manage-prompts
commands.title: Manage Prompts
commands.subtitle: PromptDeck
commands.description: Create, edit, and run reusable AI prompts.

commands.name: run-prompt
commands.title: Run Prompt
commands.subtitle: PromptDeck
commands.description: Run a saved prompt by id (used by Quicklinks).

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Default Provider
preferences.description: Provider used unless a prompt overrides it.

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Used by the OpenAI provider. Leave blank for local endpoints that need no auth, such as Ollama; hosted ones like OpenRouter still require their own key.

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Used when the resolved provider is Anthropic.

preferences.name: googleApiKey
preferences.title: Google API Key
preferences.description: Used when the resolved provider is Google.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: Default model id for the default provider.

preferences.name: baseURL
preferences.title: OpenAI-Compatible Base URL
preferences.description: Optional base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (Ollama, OpenRouter, ...). Used by the OpenAI provider only.

preferences.name: temperature
preferences.title: Temperature
preferences.description: Optional default temperature. Blank uses the provider/model default. Values outside the active provider's range are ignored.

preferences.name: reasoningLevel
preferences.title: Reasoning Level
preferences.description: Optional default reasoning effort, passed to the provider as-is. Commonly minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh or max — support varies by provider and model. Blank uses the provider default.

preferences.name: maxOutputTokens
preferences.title: Max Output Tokens
preferences.description: Optional default maximum output tokens. Blank uses the provider/model default.

preferences.name: enableHistory
preferences.title: History
preferences.label: Save prompt run history
preferences.description: Keep a local history of prompt runs, browsable via the Prompt History command.
